svg.title: Two chromosome translocation mechanisms
svg.desc: Before and after an insertional translocation: ABCDEFGH and JKLMNO become ABCDGH and JKLEFMNO. Before and after a reciprocal translocation: the same parents become ABCDEFNO and JKLMGH. Blue and green identify the two chromosome origins. Each gene block keeps its length; both examples retain every block and one centromere on each chromosome. Schematic, not genomic scale.

g.text: An internal segment (E-F) moves to another chromosome.
Chromosome ends (G-H and N-O) exchange places.
